When a graph changes, however, its eigenvalues move, and when the matrix is not symmetric, they move in the complex plane, where they can wind around each other. item.description: Scientific discovery often begins with an unexpected observation that prompts a new research question. item.description: Language models pretrained on web corpora collected over multiple years learn both general and domain-specific knowledge.
